agency-agents._note: Local MCP server — persona resolution + library scan. Reads .claude/agents/*.md + library/. Offline.

filesystem._note: Read/write project files + Claude config dir.

terminal._note: Execute local shell commands — npm, bun, git, wrangler, etc.

ast-grep._note: Structural code analysis via AST — impact radius, symbol search, refactor preview. Replaces sqlite/memory MCP.

git._note: Local git operations — status, diff, log, branch, commit, push.

docker._note: Docker local — build, run, inspect containers. Test locally before deploy.

postgres._note: Connect to local/Supabase PostgreSQL. Set DATABASE_URL in .secrets/.env

fetch._note: HTTP requests — test local APIs, external endpoints, webhooks.

puppeteer._note: Headless browser — visual/E2E tests, screenshots, scraping.

github._note: GitHub API — repos, issues, PRs, comments. Run scripts/github-app-token.js first.

supabase._note: Supabase management — migrations, projects, DB introspection. Set SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN in .secrets/.env

cloudflare._note: Cloudflare Workers/Pages deploy + management. Set tokens in .secrets/.env

sequential-thinking._note: Forces step-by-step reasoning before implementation. Mandatory pre-coding.
